title: FORTRESS
desc: Nothing about what lies inside the fortress will be revealed here; it will be up to you to find out. Fortress at Hangars Liquides is the latest artwork by builder and immersion artist Djehan Kidd. It is a megabuild that extends across an entire simulator.

title: Temple of Iris
desc: Explore the secrets of Second Life at the mystical Moth Temple of Iris.

title: Missing Mile
desc: Within the mountains of North Carolina, a mysterious dark town exists. The strange and the unusual gather here. Missing Mile is a casual roleplay sandbox inspired in part by the vampire books of Poppy Z. Brite and pop culture. It's a destination full of freedom, nostalgia, and hidden secrets to be uncovered. Let it be the stage for your imagination.

title: Verdengloom
desc: Verdengloom is a moody cliffside spot where deep green life meets shadow, fog, and quiet gothic magic. Misty paths wind through hanging vines and jagged stone, offering spaces for wandering, reflection, and calm immersion. The atmosphere shifts as you explore, and dynamic windlight activates along different paths, subtly changing the mood and deepening the sense of enchantment.

title: Innsmouth
desc: Why was this New England coastal town abandoned in the 1930s? Perhaps the giant sea-monster emerging from the south ocean might be the answer. Nevertheless, Innsmouth remains a dark, damp place with perpetual rain and ruined buildings well worth exploring.

title: What's Lost Spirits
desc: Explore a region of lost dreams, an ongoing project based on a series of vivid nightmares.

title: Death Valley
desc: Inspired by California’s Death Valley, this dystopian fantasy destination features Panamint Ghost Town, charcoal kilns, and other recognizable desert locations. Visitors can explore a harsh post-apocalyptic landscape filled with abandoned structures and hidden dangers.

title: Montecito Bay
desc: Montecito Bay is a futuristic, cyberpunk city stuck in a dystopian dream. Visit and hang out, explore, shop, and rock out to live DJs and awesome tunes! Come explore the city, get lost, and enjoy the live entertainment at night! Shop at the Avagora Mall, and discover furry/fantasy/sci-fi mods to change your look! And when you're all tuckered out, wind down at the amazing 3-floor Firecracker Arcade, or hang out on the one and only black sand beach, while you watch the Synthwave Sun set beyond the waves.

title: Tableau
desc: Explore the wonders of this desert town, including bombed-out buildings, colorful stucco construction and tumbling tumbleweeds, all situated in a tantalizing desert light. Shop, explore and enjoy the luscious scenery! Tableau is also home to many stores including Nylon Outfitters, Yummy, Paper Couture, Oh La La!, and ZsaZsa's House of Beauty.

title: Deathlands
desc: 60 years or so after the Nukecaust, a few survivors struggle to live in a dystopian future. Led by the psychotic yet handsome Rebel Wolf and his band of sociopaths, a few Deathlands "citizens" get to live in squalor and kill mutant spiders and rats, while getting poisoned by Radiation. How hot is that! How will you fare?

title: EXTINCION
desc: EXTINCTION is a bleak realm where the future has long since died, and a thick, haunting mist conceals blood, death, and decay. No one leaves this place alive. All that remains are fear, agony, and despair, lurking in the shadows, waiting for those who dare to wander too deep. EXTINCTION is a Spanish-speaking social destination open to everyone, a place where you can unleash your imagination, lose yourself for a while, or capture haunting photographs beneath a veil of pale mist, all while listening to a stream of terrifying, Halloween-inspired music. Welcome to EXTINCTION. Here, the future is dead. And the shadows are still watching.

title: Caves of the Heterocera Mountains
desc: The largest natural cave system in Second Life! Miles of caves weave through the central mountains of the Heterocera Continent. The known caves range over 4 regions. Above ground are trails and alpine terrain to explore. Be sure to tell someone where you're going and when you plan to return in case you get lost and they have to search for you!

title: Verdigris
desc: Discover the strange and precarious architecture of this vintage village, which sits atop a bridge and houses many shops for the curious buyer.

title: The GlastonBelli Cheddar Man Caves
desc: Explore the complex caves of the GlastonBelli Cheddar Man, a mysterious and cheezy spectre who navigates the integrated train system between the central caves, the local dairy, and the local bakery, in order to provide GlastonBelli visitors with the legendary GlastonBelli Cheesesteak!

title: Pyri Funfair
desc: Something sinister seems to be lurking in and around the Pyri Funfair, where you can brave the Tunnel of Love, explore a cave maze or uncover other hidden surprises.

title: Bay City Arboretum
desc: The Bay City Arboretum of Rather Atypical Vegetation hosts an evolving (in more ways than one) selection of unusual flora from Chief Gardener, Zyx Flux. Also on site is the Office of the Bay City Institute for Anomalous Research, and a memorial for Uccello Poultry.
